standard: Rendered information must be relevant to the current user, context, data, capability state and reporting period.
release_rule: Fabricated, stale, generic, unreachable or contextually misleading rendering is a product correctness defect.

confirmed_findings.finding: Seven-bar trend is hard-coded and does not represent persisted historical business data.
Progress bar is hard-coded to 70% without a verified goal denominator.
Rendered representations can imply analytical context that is not fully backed by corresponding historical/goal datasets.
Transactions, deals and staff queries rely on RLS rather than explicitly scoping the rendered dataset by business_id, while failures are converted to null and then rendered as absence.
The card title is broader than the dominant overdue/receivable fact and can communicate cash position when the underlying fact is only receivables.
Best-effort intelligence failures are swallowed, making unavailable intelligence potentially look like legitimate absence of signal.
No reporting-period selector and swallowed query failures allow zero-initialized statistics to render as real business results.
Income, expenses and net flow aggregate every loaded cashflow record without explicit period/filter semantics; failures are not rendered.
TargetsTab and CommissionsTab use empty dependency arrays despite auth business/user context arriving asynchronously, allowing permanent empty/wrong-context rendering.
Target progress lacks a zero/missing denominator guard and its reporting-period semantics are unclear.
Local month dates are converted through UTC ISO slicing, which can shift period boundaries in positive-offset locales.
Narrative is labelled FACT while loaded independently and best-effort, without shared evidence semantics with the authoritative review payload.
A default salary_software_engineer_ng benchmark is rendered regardless of user context, making generic content appear user-relevant.
RPC failures become data=null and render 'No data available', conflating failure with empty intelligence.
Explicit distinctions are required for zero, empty, unknown, loading, error, unauthorized, not configured and not connected.
New Entry validates debit/credit totals but persists only the journal header; double-entry lines are not persisted in the observed path while the UI claims a double-entry journal was created.
Balance Sheet and Income Statement values derive from account opening_balance fields rather than posted journal lines.
Account and journal query failures become empty arrays, allowing DB failure to render as no accounts or no journal entries.
CRM statistics use the full loaded deals collection while the visible list can be filtered, so headline totals can disagree with visible evidence.
Conversion is won divided by non-lost deals across the loaded dataset, with no period or denominator definition visible.
Lead headline statistics are global while the visible list can be filtered; the cards are not explicitly marked global.
Funnel percentages have no visible reporting period or denominator definition.
Task load failure sets tasks to an empty array and renders an apparently legitimate empty list.
Time tracked and estimated totals aggregate all loaded tasks without reporting-period or filter semantics.
Purchase requests, RFQs and vendors rely on RLS rather than explicit business_id predicates in the rendered query path.
PO actions route to settings and Send RFQ only changes UI stage; promised procurement operations are not performed.
Downstream workflow stages are counted from purchase_requests statuses without demonstrated transitions from RFQ/PO records.
Resend only copies the invitation URL and instructs manual sending; it does not send an invitation.
Invitation status/expiry are stored-state claims, but delivery is not evidenced by the resend flow.
Invitation deletion ignores Supabase errors and shows success regardless of whether deletion succeeded.

The page fetches only the latest 100 events for the recent-event panel and then derives unique active users and event timeline counts from that bounded set. For periods with more than 100 events, 'Active Users', timeline values and category/event context can undercount the selected time range while the Total Events card comes from a separate aggregate source.
The visible Export button has no observed click handler or export implementation, so the rendered action promises an export operation that does not occur.
getAdminAnalytics/getRecentEvents results are not represented with an explicit error state; null/empty data can become zero-valued analytics and 'No timeline/category/feature data'.
Category filtering changes the recent-event list only; summary cards and charts remain unfiltered, without communicating that scope distinction.
APISettings loads api_keys and webhooks without a business_id predicate, so displayed integration state relies entirely on RLS and is not explicitly tied to the authenticated business.

The UI explicitly describes webhooks as Beta and says event dispatching requires deployment/pg_net, so a saved webhook is rendered as configured integration despite dispatch capability not being certified on the page.

The APISettings creation path calls generate_api_key with only a name, while the UI describes REST/Zapier/Make access and the separate APIKeys page exposes permissions/scopes. The displayed key state does not demonstrate what scopes/permissions were actually granted.
Asset status updates and asset creation do not inspect Supabase errors. The UI can close/refresh and appear successful even when persistence fails.
Total Assets, Active, Maintenance and Total Value are calculated from the full asset collection while search/status/category filters affect only the visible grid; summary scope is not disclosed.

Total Value sums current_value or purchase_cost, but no valuation date, currency basis, depreciation method or source status is shown, so the figure can be read as a current financial valuation without sufficient evidence.
HR Overview renders a Public Holiday 'Tomorrow' and Performance Review 'Due in 5 days' without loading authoritative event/review dates. These are fabricated time-sensitive claims.

Overview counts pending leave and active contracts without business_id predicates while the surface is business HR state. Correctness therefore depends on RLS and can diverge from explicit tenant semantics.
Leave type options embed fixed allowances of 21/14/84/14/5 days without loading business policy or employee entitlement. The UI presents policy-like limits as universal values.
Leave request loading ignores the query error and falls back to an empty request list.

Appraisals labels a statistic 'This Year' but computes it by checking whether review_period contains the current year as text; this is not equivalent to created/review date in the current year and depends on free-form period strings.
Average rating divides by reviews with truthy rating_overall rather than the total review population, without showing how unrated reviews are handled.

Attendance shows the current clock time and today's date from the browser runtime rather than the server time used for attendance decisions. A client clock can therefore make the displayed 'Today' time disagree with authoritative attendance timing.
Present, Late, Hours and Verified metrics are calculated over the latest 31 loaded records, not a clearly defined calendar month/pay period. The UI does not disclose the 31-record scope.

The Today evidence can say 'Server verified' while location readiness is independently unavailable; verification_status is authoritative, but the combination can be read as location verification when the current browser cannot obtain location.

filterStatus is hard-coded to 'pending', making filteredHistory always empty because it explicitly returns false for that status. The page therefore renders 'No approval history yet' even when approved/rejected history was loaded.

The page comment says pending approvals are based on role, but the query loads every pending approval for the business and does not visibly filter by approver/role. The UI can therefore present requests the current user may not be the intended approver for, with the enforcement RPC only occurring at approval time.
Message query failure becomes an empty messages array and renders 'No messages yet', conflating unavailable history with a genuinely empty channel.
Sender enrichment loads staff records without an explicit business_id filter after loading messages. Correctness depends on RLS and can be broader than the selected channel's tenant context.
Only the latest 100 messages are loaded with no pagination/older-message affordance, so the channel can appear complete when history is truncated.
Reaction inserts are not checked for errors and the UI closes the picker regardless, so failed reactions can appear accepted without persistence evidence.

Changing entityFilter changes handleSearch identity but does not itself trigger a search for the existing query unless the debounced query effect runs again; the filter can therefore change visual filter state without immediately changing results.
Entity types including quotes, payments and inventory have icons/colors but are absent from routeMap, so selecting those search results falls back to /app rather than opening the matched entity.
Search errors are caught only in the UI handler and results are left as the previous result set, so a failed new query can visually retain stale results while the input shows a different query.

When no saved preferences exist, the UI presents hard-coded defaults as the current notification configuration before the user saves them. This does not prove the backend delivery policy matches those defaults.

SMS toggles include payments/reminders/security as enabled by default, while the page explicitly states SMS delivery is unavailable in this deployment. The controls can therefore imply an operational SMS channel that is not available.
The page says security emails are always sent regardless of settings, but the UI does not expose evidence of the actual transactional email policy or delivery state.

The UI filters admin announcements by status but does not visibly apply start_date/end_date to the rendered list, while announcement records contain scheduling fields. Future/expired active announcements can therefore be displayed as active content.

The user-facing list maps all business announcements into userAnnouncements without visible filtering by target_type/target_ids, so department/team/role/individual targeting is not demonstrated in the rendering path.
View count is read-modify-write from the admin-loaded announcement object rather than an atomic increment, so concurrent views can be lost and displayed counts can be inaccurate.
Enable/disable mutations are not guarded by the page's canManage check even though deletion is. Actual safety depends on RLS rather than consistent UI authorization semantics.
The reveal control never reveals the raw key; it replaces the masked prefix with another masked placeholder. The UI exposes an eye control that implies reveal capability it does not provide.

The list interface contains expiry and rotation fields, but the primary display does not show expiry dates, so an expiring or expired key can appear simply Active unless backend enforcement is consulted elsewhere.
Legacy Capture is intentionally redirected to Meetings, avoiding a second disconnected capture surface. No rendering defect found on this compatibility route.

copilot_messages loading does not surface its query error; historyLoaded becomes true even when history retrieval fails, so the UI can present the fresh-start state and imply no prior conversation rather than history being unavailable.

Assistant responses carry sources/confidence in state but the rendered message only displays provider badge. The user is told Sarah is grounded in live data without seeing the evidence sources or confidence that the backend supplied.

required_checks: Every displayed number traces to authoritative current data.
Every chart traces to real data points.
Every percentage has a defined numerator and denominator.
Every date/time label matches its actual reporting period.
Every rendered action performs the promised operation.
Role, entitlement and selected-tool context control what is rendered.
Tenant boundaries are preserved in displayed data.
Unavailable capabilities do not render as operational.
Empty/error/loading/not-configured states are semantically distinct.
Mobile rendering preserves business meaning and critical actions.
No illustrative data is presented as live business data.
No fixed progress, trend or health score is presented without an authoritative source.
Visible counts agree with the underlying filtered dataset.
Visible labels describe the actual entity, status and time period being shown.
Filters and tabs change the evidence shown, not just the visual chrome.
Auth-dependent queries re-run when the authenticated business/user context becomes available.
Best-effort intelligence failures are visible as unavailable/error rather than indistinguishable from empty data.
Composite cards name the exact fact being shown rather than a broader business concept.
Default benchmark/insight panels are contextually relevant or explicitly user-selected.
Financial statements are derived from posted journal lines, not merely opening balances.
Business workflow buttons execute their labelled backend operation rather than only navigating or changing UI state.
Headline summaries disclose whether they are global, filtered, paginated or period-scoped.
Time-sensitive announcements and scheduled content obey their effective windows.
Targeted content is filtered by the current user's audience attributes.
Admin analytics aggregates disclose their source window and truncation limits.
Integration controls do not imply capabilities that are not deployed or verified.
Client-side controls do not imply backend delivery guarantees without delivery evidence.
Search results remain actionable for every supported entity type.
Financial/HR policy constants are loaded from authoritative business policy where applicable.
Security-sensitive mutations have consistent authorization semantics.
